A statistic fitted at depth 2 conflates 675 (FILESYSTEM), 337 (SQLITE) and 321 (TARBALL) pairs of depth-3 runs, and only 10 of the 321 change a verdict. truth.the_law_this_round_adds: A conflation is not an error and a counterexample is not a statistic. Sufficiency is a statement about verdicts, not cells, so the coarsest statistic may conflate thousands of pairs and be right about every run; a counterexample is enough on its own, but harm is not where disagreement, refinement cost or novelty is, so it can only be asked for -- at one question per run minus one per cell.
what_is_false_in_the_claim: that a colliding statistic is a failing one: 675 FILESYSTEM collisions and 1765 TARBALL depth-4 collisions, 0 harmful, 87/87 verdicts right
that a free-running loop finds the counterexample: two computable orderings ask six questions, meet none, and rank the first harmful pair at 130 and 136 of 321 where chance expects 29
that committee disagreement is information: 311 of 321 pairs tie, so the ordering is index order
that the vocabulary blocked the repair: 779 sufficient statistics existed at depth 3 and the coarsest was one generator from the shallow winner
that a passing suite is acceptance: a statistic can abstain on 31 of 87 runs, or conflate 1765 pairs and answer all 87 correctly, and both are different from knowing
